title: Fear Is the Sign You're Evolving
one_liner: Your ego projects a fictitious future to stop you from making courageous, soul-aligned choices.
key_points: Fear during a big life decision is a signal of growth, not a reason to retreat
The ego clings to false security (like a paycheck) to avoid the 'death' of an old self
Projecting scary futures that haven't happened yet is the mind using fiction to block action
Doubt kills more ideas than failure — courage to act shifts you onto an entirely new timeline
